Version 0.0.6.0 - Rebuild
This rebuild is the biggest update yet, I have redesigned this from a browser to a whole windows experience. functions closely like windows 11.
+ changelogs.json - this is in a json so i dont have to keep updating the damn index.html
+ playlist.csv - now i can use spotify to show you my music taste, used a csv to create my own design and remove spotify 100 song preview limitations.
+ added 3 new tabs, PLAYLIST (Spotify, Online), Info (info about the site), Settings (self explanatory).
+ sw.js - this saves the site, is the backbone of the settings, so u dont have to spend data on loading again.
+ socials.json - new SOCIALS tab in !NF0, filled from a json file. Spotify, YouTube, Discord and Roblox are in there, add or remove lines whenever.
+ full repo link in !NF0 > About.
+ sw.js now saves socials.json too, so the tab works offline.
+ phones held upright now get the landscape layout (the page is turned sideways), so people rotate their phone.
+ on-screen keyboard for the search bars on phones - it floats up when you tap a search bar and disappears when you tap away, so the phone's own portrait keyboard never opens.
- favourite bands section, old nonfunctioning designs
- version label in the ARCH!VE window title
* the whole design
* archive layout - now 2 medium + 3 small boxes (3 small in one row, 2 medium under them, 1 column on phones), so the banner gets the leftover space and fits properly.

* readme tab - ### headings and
line breaks now show up properly instead of as raw text.
* small phones - the taskbar shows its labels again and the playlist gets a compact layout so the song list has room and scrolls.
